boca_exprosiv3d v1.1
====================

- Increased secondary-flash sphere tessellation from 8x4 to 16x8.
- Increased secondary-flash lobe tessellation from 7x3 to 12x6.
- Increased gas-cloud tessellation from 7x3 to 10x5.
- Made the primary secondary-flash volume truly spherical by setting length1 = radius.
- Raised primitive tessellation caps in the public header to 16 sides and 8 stacks.
- Updated documentation and recommended shared mesh-buffer sizes for the higher-detail build.
